methodology.percentile: Sorted values; rank=(n-1)*p; linear interpolation between floor(rank) and ceil(rank). Median uses p=0.5 and p95 uses p=0.95.
methodology.statisticsPopulation: Successful measured runs only. Failed runs and warmups remain in raw.jsonl and failure counts, but not timing or memory percentiles.
methodology.memory: KiB. Each iteration schedules aggregate RSS sampling every 50 ms for the Node driver and attributed Chrome tree, then takes the peak. Statistics summarize those per-iteration peaks.
methodology.cleanup: browser.close() has 250 ms to finish. If the owned Chrome tree stalls it, the runner allows 100 ms for orphaned helpers, then signals only owned Chrome processes. SIGTERM has 250 ms before SIGKILL. Forced cleanup counts are reported.
